# PDF.js 5.6.205

Browser builds and supporting assets from Mozilla's `pdfjs-dist` package,
distributed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

The installed runtime's `build/pdf.min.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`
are stored here as `pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs`. The character maps,
standard fonts, WebAssembly decoders, and ICC profiles are included so
document previews work without a CDN.

Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
